# 金山词霸开放平台 (Kingsoft Iciba Open Platform)

> > A comprehensive API platform for Chinese-English dictionary services with XML/JSON support, enabling developers to integrate word lookup and translation capabilities into applications.

金山词霸开放平台 provides developer-friendly access to Kingsoft's renowned dictionary database through standardized APIs. The platform supports multiple data formats (XML and JSON) and offers phonetic pronunciation data alongside translations, making it ideal for language learning applications, translation tools, and multilingual software development.

## Key Topics

- 金山词霸 (Kingsoft Iciba)
- 开放平台 (Open Platform)
- Dictionary API
- Word Lookup Interface
- XML Format
- JSON Format
- Chinese-English Translation
- Phonetic Pronunciation
- Developer Platform
- dict-co.iciba.com
- API Documentation
- Language Data
